cues.text: Naganaki Shrine. You sit beside Akinari on a bench, and he smiles at you.
Akinari hands you a worn notebook. Then he gets to his feet and turns a little away from you.
Akinari smiles at you. In a flash of light he breaks into drifting sparks until he is gone. You get up with a start and look to where he stood, your face falling.
